input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: The cap is mutual and the carve-outs in § 21.3 (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) plus the payment-obligation carve-back meet the preferred position on those elements. However, the cap basis fails even the fallback: "Fees" is defined (§ 1.5/1.6) as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, and the cap is further limited to amounts under "the first Order Form", so the ceiling is roughly USD 12,000 regardless of actual spend — far below 6 months' fees and effectively illusory. We made the minimal edit to § 21.1 to base the cap on all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement in the preceding twelve months with a USD 1,000,000 floor, leaving mutuality, exclusions and Excluded Claims untouched.

proposal.summary: Re-base the mutual cap on 12 months' amounts paid or payable under the Agreement, with a USD 1,000,000 floor, instead of the USD 12,000 implementation fee under the first Order Form.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] As drafted the cap is measured by "Fees", which is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the mutual cap is illusory; our position is the greater of twelve months' amounts paid or payable and USD 1,000,000. Excluded Claims (including indemnification, confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches) remain outside the cap, and Customer's payment obligations remain unaffected.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000
